'''Unit 26''', also known as '''Unit 2-6''', was a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] who participated in the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]].

==History==
The droid dressed up in [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] in an attempt to fool [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and convince them to leave the [[Rishi Station/Legends|station]]. When the two witnessed a [[Droid attack flare/Legends|droid attack flare]], Rex realized that they were being deceived by a droid and immediately shot Unit 26 in the face.

Their head was later used to trick [[09/Legends|Unit 09]] into opening the station doors to let the surviving [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] back in.
